resource "aws_instance" "datalake_etl" {
  ami                                  = data.aws_ssm_parameter.al2023.insecure_value
  instance_type                        = "t3.micro"
  subnet_id                            = sort(data.aws_subnets.default.ids)[0]
  vpc_security_group_ids               = [aws_security_group.datalake_etl_sg.id]
  associate_public_ip_address          = true
  iam_instance_profile                 = aws_iam_instance_profile.datalake_etl.name
  instance_initiated_shutdown_behavior = "terminate"
  user_data_replace_on_change          = true

  # No key_name: no key pair exists for this host. Access = SSM only.
  user_data = <<-EOT
    #!/bin/bash
    systemctl disable --now sshd.service sshd.socket 2>/dev/null || true
    shutdown -h +${var.ttl_minutes} "ASCC spike TTL reached"
  EOT

  metadata_options {
    http_endpoint               = "enabled"
    http_tokens                 = "required"
    http_put_response_hop_limit = 1
  }

  root_block_device {
    encrypted   = true
    volume_size = 8
    volume_type = "gp3"
  }

  tags = { Name = "datalake-etl" }
}
